data.name: Faghira
data.gender_notes: Faghira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'faghara', meaning 'to be victorious or triumphant'. In Islamic tradition, Faghira is a name of strength and resilience, reminding us of the triumphant power of faith and perseverance. The name Faghira carries the meaning “Powerful, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faghira usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual victory of the believer over their inner struggles and external challenges.
data.etymology: Faghira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faghira total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
